page_title: ALA 1-1 MAL | Alaves v Mallorca 24/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+6' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.
90+4' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
90+3' Toni Lato (Mallorca) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
90+1' Referee halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Luis Garcia Plaza, then promptly shows him a RED CARD!
90+1' A substitution has been made. Sergi Darder goes off and Samu Costa (Mallorca) comes on.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
88' 1 - 1 Goal! Matija Nastasic (Mallorca) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low into the middle of the net. It's 1:1.
86' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) receives a pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it towards the left post. Unfortunately for him, Antonio Sivera makes a great save to stop his effort.
85' The substitution has been made. Ruben Duarte (Alaves) has replaced Luis Rioja.
85' It is time for a substitution. Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) is on for Andoni Gorosabel.
84' Javier Aguirre has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Javier Llabres (Mallorca) replacing Jose Copete.
84' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) is coming onto the pitch as Omar Mascarell cannot continue after picking up an injury.
82' The number of shots on goal at present is 1:5.
80' The corner is swung in but Mallorca can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
79' Jose Copete (Mallorca) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked. Mallorca have a corner.

76' 1 - 0 A perfectly taken corner kick. Carlos Benavidez (Alaves) gets on the end of it and produces a fantastic bullet header from around the penalty spot into the bottom left corner, increasing the score of today's match – 1:0.
76' Luis Rioja (Alaves) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
75' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Predrag Rajkovic, who smothers the ball. It will be a corner kick for Alaves.
72' Luis Garcia Plaza prepares a substitution. Samu Omorodion is replaced by Kike Garcia (Alaves).
72' Substitution. Carlos Benavidez (Alaves) has come on for Antonio Blanco.
70' Alaves fail to score from a corner as Predrag Rajkovic (Mallorca) leaps to collect the ball.
69' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) inside the box following a slide rule pass. Mallorca force their opponents to concede a corner.
68' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.

65' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team.
60' Today's match ends for Alex Sola who will be replaced by Carlos Vicente (Alaves).
60' Javier Aguirre has decided to make a change. Giovanni Alessandro Gonzalez Apud (Mallorca) replaces Nacho Vidal.
60' A substitution has been made. Nemanja Radonjic is replaced by Cyle Larin (Mallorca).
59' Martin Valjent (Mallorca) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
58' The referee blows his whistle as Antonio Blanco (Alaves) was too aggressive in his challenge.
54' Victor Garcia shows a yellow card to Nacho Vidal (Mallorca) for his blatant foul.
53' Nemanja Radonjic (Mallorca) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.

50' Javi Lopez (Alaves) shows off his skills with a mazy run to the edge of the box and then fires in a disappointing shot that flies high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
48' Sergi Darder almost gets into in a promising position, but the through ball by Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) from just inside the box is intercepted by one of the defending players.
46' Referee Victor Garcia blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+1' The match has reached half-time.
44' A pass from Nacho Vidal (Mallorca) is intercepted by Antonio Sivera and the move breaks down.
42' Alex Sola (Alaves) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
39' The shots on goal statistics – 0:4.
36' Samu Omorodion (Alaves) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.

34' Abdel Abqar (Alaves) picks up the rebound from his own attempted pass and decides to shoot from mid-range. He shouldn't have bothered as the ball flies miles over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.
33' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Alaves.
33' Nemanja Radonjic (Mallorca) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
31' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) commits a foul and Victor Garcia immediately signals a free kick.

30' What an opportunity! Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) squanders a huge opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes just wide of the left post! The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.

29' Nemanja Radonjic (Mallorca) and Vedat Muriqi have been trying to find each other with some accurate passes ever since the match started. These two definitely combine the most and are the team's most creative players.
28' Mallorca work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
24' Nemanja Radonjic (Mallorca) picks up a pass on the edge of the box and manages to get a powerful shot away, forcing the goalkeeper to scramble to his left and palm the ball away.
22' Mallorca get a corner.

21' Nemanja Radonjic (Mallorca) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Antonio Sivera. The ball goes out of play. Mallorca are awarded a corner kick.
18' Andoni Gorosabel (Alaves) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.

14' CLOSE! Nemanja Radonjic (Mallorca) shows off his amazing skills with a solo run to the edge of the box before fashioning a shot that whistles over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Alaves.
14' The ball is cleared after Andoni Gorosabel (Alaves) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
10' One of the Mallorca players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
10' Matija Nastasic (Mallorca) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
9' Nemanja Radonjic (Mallorca) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
3' The Alaves players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
1' The first half has just begun.
Mallorca will kick the game off.
Victor Garcia will officiate today.
